name: True Religion
overview: True religion, as revealed in Scripture, centers on a heartfelt reverence for God expressed through obedience and humble service. God requires His people to fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him fully, and keep His commandments, which encompasses doing justice, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Him. This genuine devotion rejects defilement through occult practices and is exemplified in the sinless life of Christ, who lived without deceit or violence. Ultimately, true religion is the whole duty of man—living in reverent obedience to God’s will.
